sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
In Candy Super Match, the core gameplay revolves around switching and matching candies to create combinations of three or more in a row. The objective is to create as many matches as possible within a given time limit, while navigating through increasingly challenging levels and obstacles.

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter various power-ups, boosters, and special candies that will help you clear the board and earn bonus points. Some of the special candies include the Striped Candy, which clears an entire row or column of candies, and the Wrapped Candy, which explodes and clears a large area of the board.

The game also features a variety of obstacles, such as the Ice Candy, which freezes the board and prevents you from making any moves, and the Chocolate Candy, which eats a random candy on the board. Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Candy Super Match are simple yet engaging, making it easy to pick up and play, but difficult to put down.
